intro: Camping 101: Tailoring introduces clothiers to the art of crafting specialized equipment for wilderness campsites. By demonstrating skill to Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village, tailors learn to sew an inspirational Faction Banner that raises spirits and sustains camp morale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
